title: Fix handle_group_live returning 211 for unknown groups
description: reader/session/lifecycle.rs handle_group_live validates group name syntax but does not check ctx.known_groups. GROUP <any-valid-name> succeeds with 211 0 1 0 even for groups not served. RFC 3977 §6.1.1 requires 411. Fix: check known_groups in handle_group_live.
